items.title: Turkcell CEO Ali Taha Koç Appointed Chair of the GSMA Technology Group
items.summary: ISTANBUL, July 07, 2026--Turkcell (NYSE: TKC, BIST: TCELL) CEO Dr. Ali Taha Koç has been appointed Chair of the GSMA Technology Group, part of the GSMA, the world's leading mobile industry organization representing more than 1,000 operators and companies worldwide. items.title: 61 Organizations Win Prestigious ATD BEST Award
items.summary: The Association for Talent Development (ATD) honored 61 organizations from around the globe with 2026 BEST Awards. Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş.—a three-time winner based in Istanbul, Turkey—won the first-place ranking.
